name: Camping Aufenfeld
beschreibung: Camping Aufenfeld in Aschau im Zillertal, Tyrol, offers an idyllic natural setting with views of the Zillertal Alps. The campsite is situated directly by the Zillertal stream, surrounded by extensive forests, offering a quiet and secluded location. The atmosphere is relaxed and pristine, ideal for nature lovers and family holidays. Guests can choose between various pitches and benefit from modern sanitary facilities, a dishwasher, and a communal barbecue area. Hiking and outdoor activities are accessible directly from the campsite, and the nearby village provides shopping amenities and dining options.
